subject.title: fix(ai): honor Responses reasoning effort maps

question: Should this PR land with the explicit OpenAI-or-Azure encrypted-replay boundary, with future compatible endpoints added only after their continuation contract is verified?
rationale: The code is mechanically consistent for the routes covered, but selecting which third-party Responses endpoints may receive encrypted replay material is a compatibility and session-continuation contract that needs owner intent.

options.title: Accept the explicit replay boundary
options.body: Land the current route-specific boundary and require future providers to add continuation proof before receiving encrypted reasoning material.

options.title: Generalize only with a model capability
options.body: Delay landing until replay support is represented as explicit model metadata rather than inferred from the current OpenAI and Azure route identities.

recommendation.title: Accept the explicit replay boundary
recommendation.body: Land the current route-specific boundary and require future providers to add continuation proof before receiving encrypted reasoning material.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned on the PR and is the strongest available owner for the remaining compatibility-contract decision.
